episodes.title: Welcome to Your Life
episodes.summary: After a devastating tragedy, Frank and Joe Hardy, together with their father Fenton, move to the small town of Bridgepoint to spend the summer with their Aunt Trudy. Their simple summer plans quickly come to an end when they discover their dad has taken on a secret investigation and Joe's life is threatened. Realizing that their Dad may be onto something, the boys take it upon themselves to start an investigation of their own.

episodes.title: Where the Light Can't Find You
episodes.summary: When Fenton heads overseas to find Mrs. Khan's nephew, Rupert, he quickly realizes that whatever Rupert and Laura were working on garnered attention in Bridgeport. Meanwhile, Frank discovers an old note of his mom's in Bridgeport that mentions the sunken fishing boat and Joe and his new friend Biff befriend a man on the beach who asks them to help him by delivering a message.

episodes.title: Of Freedom and Pleasure
episodes.summary: Joe finds a strange golden idol hidden in his room, but when he accidentally breaks it, inside is a strange piece of broken stone that he stashes in his pocket. Later that day at the Bridgeport Fair Joe gets lucky, but he also draws the attention of the Tall Man. Meanwhile, Frank discovers some information about an old mining expedition that ended in tragedy and the boys start to wonder what their Mom was investigating.

episodes.title: Secrets and Lies
episodes.summary: When the thief's campsite is discovered, Joe is terrified that the toolbox he lent the man on the beach has been found by the police. Trying to hide his connection to the criminal, Joe enlists Biff to help him get his monogrammed soldering iron – that he kept in the toolbox – out of evidence at the police department. Frank confronts his Grandmother after learning she had an argument with his mom.

episodes.title: The Drop
episodes.summary: Joe and Frank decode a message that leads them to try and make a drop at the warehouse, despite the fact the message was intercepted by Police Chief Ezra Collig. The drop goes awry, but later when the boys return looking for more clues, they find a piece of fabric that the person fleeing the warehouse left behind. When the Tall Man escapes from the hospital, the boys reveal their entire investigation to their friends and get their help to lure the Tall Man to Chet's farm.

episodes.title: In Plain Sight
episodes.summary: Frank relents and takes the entrance exam to Rosegrave Preparatory School. Callie Shaw is also taking the test and the two become close as they work together to solve the exam's last escape room puzzle in Gloria's study. Unwittingly they discover a hidden door, marked by a similar symbol they've seen before. Meanwhile, when Joe finds out the Tall Man has escaped from jail, he quickly tries to find a safe place for his lucky charm.

episodes.title: A Figure in Hiding
episodes.summary: Frank and Callie make a visit to Rosegrave Prep where Frank learns the Dean had a close connection to his mother… one the Dean feels unsafe discussing with Frank. Joe and Biff continue to investigate the scrap of fabric from the warehouse and make a discovery that leaves Biff conflicted. Mrs. Khan makes a play for the missing piece of The Eye by enlisting the Tall Man. However, things don't exactly go as planned when the Tall Man goes after Frank and Joe to get the missing piece.

episodes.title: What Happened in Bridgeport
episodes.summary: Frank befriends Stacy, the new girl in town, after an accident. The Hardy boys start the school year in Bridgeport, since their dad is still away. Frank discovers his mom used to write for the high school paper and was investigating the most powerful families in Bridgeport… including the Estabrooks. J.B. Cox tries to put the squeeze on Joe to find out what he knows about The Eye, but Joe denies having what J.B. wants… his lucky charm.

episodes.title: The Key
episodes.summary: When J.B. Cox offers Joe up to Gloria, he is hired to find the other two pieces of the Eye. Joe's lucky charm goes missing and Aunt Trudy uncovers the boys' investigation. Elsewhere, Fenton rescues Rupert Khan and learns what he and Laura were working on. Frank and Joe discover their mother's music box holds a secret.

episodes.title: The Secret Room
episodes.summary: After gaining access to George Estabrook's Secret Room, Frank and Joe take their great-grandfather's journal and maps to learn more about The Eye. Despite Frank warning them of danger, Joe and Biff strike out alone to find the Chamber of the Eye. Meanwhile, Callie grows increasingly suspicious and jealous of Stacy, upsetting Chet in the process. Frank confronts Stacy and discovers the truth behind her move to Bridgeport.

episodes.title: No Getting Out
episodes.summary: The town of Bridgeport is put under curfew with Joe and Biff missing. Frank realizes they must have gone looking for the Chamber of the Eye. When Frank asks Gloria for help finding the Chamber, Gloria doesn't know anything about an entrance to the old, sealed, mine tunnels so Frank must turn to Stacy for help. Frank lets Officer Jesse Hooper in on their investigation, and the boys find themselves in more danger than they'd expected.

episodes.title: Eye to Eye
episodes.summary: Frank has no choice but to side with his grandmother and play her game if he wants to get close enough to destroy The Eye. Fenton returns to Bridgeport with Rupert Khan and learns that Joe and Frank have gotten themselves farther along in their investigation than he could imagine. But when Fenton tries to get Frank to leave the Estabrook Estate, his son refuses. Stacy, being spurned by Frank, takes revenge, and puts one of Frank's friends in danger.

episodes.title: While the Clock Ticked
episodes.summary: Frank and Chet find a way to rescue their friend without giving up the Estabrook piece of The Eye to Stacy, while Joe, Biff and Phil break into the Estabrook Estate looking for the missing piece, but they're too late. The Hardy boys with Fenton's help will have to find their way to the hidden Chamber to stop the Circle from reuniting the Eye. What happens next changes everything for the Hardy boys!

episodes.title: A Disappearance
episodes.summary: Frank and Joe Hardy return to detective work when a classmate goes missing.

episodes.title: Conflicting Reports
episodes.summary: Joe suspects Dennis's girlfriend, Lucy, is hiding something about the night he went missing, and Frank realizes The Eye is trying to show him something about the case.

episodes.title: The Missing Camera
episodes.summary: When Frank is led to believe a local recluse is their prime suspect, the friends attempt a risky break and enter to retrieve the video camera Dennis lost in the woods.

episodes.title: A Clue on Film
episodes.summary: It's a waiting game as Callie tries to repair Dennis's damaged videotape, and the gang all attend the annual Demon Night Drive-in.

episodes.title: Heading for Destruction
episodes.summary: The gang race to stop a potential bombing at the Demon Day Parade, while Fenton makes a shocking discovery of his own.

episodes.title: Hunting an Intruder
episodes.summary: In the aftermath of the bombing, the friends realize Wilt's may not have been the intended target.

episodes.title: The Doctor's Orders
episodes.summary: When Dr. Burelli plans to move Dennis to another facility, Joe fears the worst and convinces Lucy, Biff and Phil to help him stop her.

episodes.title: A Midnight Scare
episodes.summary: Frank and Callie make a shocking revelation about the Project Midnight test subjects, while Joe impatiently tries to enlist the help of J.B. Cox to get the power out of Frank.

episodes.title: Captured!
episodes.summary: Joe conspires with J.B. to steal The Relic from Stratemeyer Global and get the power out of Frank, but The Eye has other plans.

episodes.title: An Unexpected Return
episodes.summary: With Frank missing from the school dance, Joe and the gang must race against time to locate his whereabouts and stop the Shadow Man from completing his ultimate plan.

episodes.title: A Strange Inheritance
episodes.summary: When the gang learns the location of George Estabrook's hidden Codexes, they must enlist the help of an unlikely ally to retrieve them before anyone else.

episodes.title: A Vanishing Act
episodes.summary: Betrayed by one of their own, the gang struggles to understand the meaning behind George Estabrook's map and faces a shocking quid pro quo.

episodes.title: A Promise of Trouble
episodes.summary: The gang joins Callie at Rosegrave with hopes of saving Frank, but they'll require the help of an old foe and The Power of The Eye.

episodes.title: The Crash
episodes.summary: With Frank back, the race is on to locate the third and final Relic, but the bad guys are hot on the Hardy Boys' trail.

episodes.title: Revelation
episodes.summary: After a shocking blow, the gang must divide and conquer to determine the identity of Deep Voice and get The Core back.

episodes.title: The Spider's Net
episodes.summary: With the help of Drew, the gang makes a daring plan to retrieve The Core, but their loved ones' lives hang in the balance.

episodes.title: At the Old House
episodes.summary: The Hardy Boys get what they want most and must race to deactivate The Core before it's too late.

episodes.title: A Wild Ride
episodes.summary: As The Core's true purpose is revealed, the Hardy Boys and their friends must band together to save themselves, and the world, from an unheard-of technology that could forever change life as they know it.
